title: Legal Fastlane: automated triage & pricing guardrails for high-risk contract redlines
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Legal are spending increasing time negotiating MSA/DPA indemnity and liability clauses for enterprise deals, delaying closes and causing unpredictable revenue leakage. We need a repeatable operational flow that (1) triages redlines automatically, (2) enforces pricing/protection guardrails when concessions are made, and (3) reduces manual handoffs to Legal for low-risk exceptions.

Goal: Deliver a 'Legal Fastlane' system and playbook that integrates contract redline scoring, price-impact telemetry, and an approvals automation engine. This should enable predictable time-to-approve for low/medium risk redlines and surface only high-risk items to Legal with prepopulated negotiation language and pricing guidance for Sales.

Scope (MVP):
- Redline ingestion from e-signature and sales repo (DocuSign/Drive + Salesforce attachments).
- Automated redline classifier that tags items: indemnity, unlimited liability, source code escrow, IP assignment, security SOW, data residency.
- Risk scoring matrix (legal risk + revenue sensitivity) and mapping to approval path: auto-approve, sales manager review, legal expedited review, legal full review.
- Price-protection slider in Salesforce quote UI that enforces minimum price or flags required discounts when sales accept concession.
- Playbook for negotiators with canned fallback language and recommended fees/credits tied to concession type.
- Telemetry dashboard showing concession velocity, average time-to-approve by risk bucket, and expected ARR impact.

Out of scope for MVP: full ML-based clause rewriting, integrated signing flow changes, multi-jurisdictional localized legal templates beyond primary US/EU variants.

Acceptance criteria:
1) P0 redline classes are reliably detected with >= 92% precision on a 200-sample pilot corpus.
2) Automated triage routes 55% of incoming redlines to auto-approve or sales-manager paths (reducing legal touches).
3) Salesforce quote UI shows pricing guardrail and prevents approval without recorded concession reason and applied fee/credit when guardrail exceeded.
4) Dashboard surfaces top 5 recurring concession types and an estimated monthly ARR delta.
5) Legal sign-off on playbook language for auto-approve and expedited templates.

Risks and mitigations:
- False negatives on high-risk redlines: initial pilot retains manual sampling and weekly legal spot checks; escalate to expedited review if classifier confidence < 0.6.
- Sales friction from price-protection UX: work with Growth to A/B test messaging and soft warnings in first two cycles.
- Contractual/regulatory edge cases (e.g., government customers): add whitelist to always route to Legal.

Deliverables:
- Technical spec for redline ingestion + classifier (Confluence link), classifier training dataset (200 labeled redlines), and an evaluation script.
- Salesforce UI changes and validation rules (PR in our internal repo).
- Playbook PDF for Sales & Legal (Confluence + Google Drive).
- Telemetry dashboard (Looker/Grafana) with initial widgets.

Key stakeholders: Legal (Anika Rivera), Sales Ops (James Chen), GTM lead (Priya Kapoor), Security & Compliance (Oscar Li), Engineering owner (Sahil Mehta).

Dependencies: PM-20501, PM-24680, ENG-41230, ENG-42100.

Success metrics (90 day): 30% reduction in legal review volume for redlines, median approval time for medium-risk redlines < 72 hours, measurable reduction in discretionary concessions worth > $50k ARR/month avoided.
